Title: Sr. AI Engineer
Location: San Pedro Garza García, Nuevo León, Mexico
Description: Johnson Controls International (JCI) is seeking a Senior AI Engineer to join our innovative and impact-driven Data Science and Analytics team. This role is ideal for a seasoned expert with a deep understanding of machine learning, AI, and cloud data platforms, and a strong grasp of the latest advancements in Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Senior AI Engineer, you will lead the development and deployment of scalable AI solutions—including those powered by LLMs—to accelerate digital transformation across our products, operations, and customer experiences. You'll play a critical role in shaping JCI’s AI engineering strategy, mentoring teams, and driving the use of AI to deliver measurable business value. How You Will Do It Advanced Analytics, LLMs & Modeling Design and implement advanced machine learning models including deep learning, time-series forecasting, recommendation engines, and LLM-based solutions (e.g., GPT, LLaMA, Claude). Develop use cases around enterprise search, document summarization, conversational AI, and automated knowledge retrieval using large language models. Fine-tune or prompt-engineer foundation models (e.g., OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Hugging Face) for domain-specific applications. Evaluate and optimize LLM performance, latency, cost-effectiveness, and hallucination mitigation strategies for production use. Data Strategy & Engineering Collaboration Work closely with data and ML engineering teams to integrate LLM-powered applications into scalable, secure, and reliable pipelines. Contribute to the development of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures using vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Azure Cognitive Search). Support the deployment of models using MLOps principles, ensuring robust monitoring and lifecycle management. Business Impact & AI Strategy Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to identify opportunities for applying LLMs and generative AI to solve complex business challenges. Lead workshops or proofs-of-concept to demonstrate value of LLM use cases across business units. Translate complex model outputs, including those from LLMs, into clear insights and decision support tools for non-technical audiences. Thought Leadership & Mentorship Act as an internal thought leader on AI and LLM innovation, keeping JCI at the forefront of industry advancements. Mentor and upskill AI engineering team members in advanced AI techniques, including transformer models and generative AI frameworks. Contribute to strategic roadmaps for generative AI and model governance within the enterprise. Qualifications & Experience Education in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, or related quantitative discipline. 5+ years of hands-on experience in AI engineering, data science, or machine learning, including at least 1–2 years working with LLMs or generative AI technologies. Demonstrated success in deploying machine learning and NLP solutions at scale. Proven experience with cloud AI platforms—especially Azure OpenAI, Azure ML, Hugging Face, or AWS Bedrock. Technical Expertise Proficiency in Python and SQL, including libraries like Transformers (Hugging Face), Microsoft Agent Framework, LangChain, PyTorch, and TensorFlow. Experience with prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and LLM orchestration tools. Familiarity with data storage, retrieval systems, and vector databases. Strong understanding of model evaluation techniques for generative AI, including factuality, relevance, and toxicity metrics. Leadership & Soft Skills Strategic thinker with a strong ability to align AI initiatives to business goals. Excellent communication and storytelling skills, especially in articulating the value of LLMs and advanced analytics. Strong collaborator with a track record of influencing stakeholders across product, engineering, and executive teams. Preferred Qualifications Experience with IoT, edge analytics, or smart building systems. Familiarity with LLMOps, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or similar orchestration frameworks. Knowledge of data privacy and governance considerations specific to LLM usage in enterprise environments. Title: HR Data & Compliance Analyst
Description: Description Position at Ziff Davis The Opportunity: Ziff Davis's HR Compliance & Analytics team keeps our workforce data accurate, audit-ready, and useful to the leaders who rely on it. We're looking for an HR Data & Compliance Analyst to be the team's hands-on execution partner: preparing statutory filings and audit evidence, running recurring data validation and reconciliation across our HR platforms, and building and maintaining the dashboards and reporting suites that GMs, HR Partners, and HR leadership use every day. You'll turn raw HCM, payroll, and recruiting data into accurate, audit-ready outputs that leadership can trust. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Sr. Manager, HR Compliance & Analytics. You'll work closely with HR Systems on integration health and access reviews, with the HR Coordination team and record owners to fix data at the source, with HR Partners and business leaders on reporting and analysis, and with Legal to track regulatory changes such as new state pay transparency and reporting laws. Our workforce data spans multiple business units, so you'll see how data moves end to end across HCM, payroll, recruiting, and finance systems. This is a remote position. Key Responsibilities: In this role, you will: Build, refresh, and maintain HR dashboards for GMs, HR Partners, and HR leadership, connecting HCM, payroll, recruiting, and finance data, applying role-based security, and supporting users through guides and training to drive self-service adoption. Validate dashboard outputs against source systems before each release, documenting metric definitions and data lineage. Prepare the monthly and quarterly workforce reporting suites, including headcount, hires, terminations, attrition, and span of control by business unit. Test and tune natural-language and AI query tools, logging incorrect answers and maintaining the metric glossary those tools rely on. Fulfill ad hoc data requests from HR Partners and business leaders, turning recurring requests into self-service reports. Pull, clean, and validate data for federal, state, and local workforce compliance filings, and maintain the compliance filing calendar with deadlines, owners, and submission confirmations. Execute scheduled audits of employee files, required system fields, employment eligibility, wage/hour data, and policy adherence, documenting findings and corrective actions. Assemble evidence packages and data extracts for external labor audits, regulatory inquiries, and discovery requests. Run recurring reconciliations across HCM, payroll, recruiting, and finance systems (e.g., change forms vs. HCM records, rosters vs. headcount reports) and drive fixes with record owners and the HR Coordination team. Monitor adherence to field validation standards and mandatory field requirements, reporting data-quality trends monthly. Prepare datasets and first-pass analysis for pay equity, compensation band, and job classification audits, and support predictive model development by sourcing features, cleaning historical data, and tracking model accuracy over time. Coordinate periodic role-based access reviews, from generating user lists and collecting manager attestations to tracking removals to completion. Monitor new-hire provisioning and termination deprovisioning against HR events, and perform daily/weekly checks on HCM integrations and file feeds, triaging failures with HR Systems. Maintain the HR risk register, keeping status, owners, and remediation dates current and preparing summaries for leadership review. Track regulatory changes (e.g., new state pay transparency or reporting laws) and flag impacts on data, filings, or processes. Support annual testing of the HR components of the ADP Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity Plans, documenting results and follow-ups. Job Qualifications: Required: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 3+ years of experience in HR analytics, HRIS, HR compliance, or people data operations. Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills (lookups, pivots, data cleaning). Hands-on experience building dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a native HCM analytics tool. Working knowledge of US employment compliance and statutory reporting requirements. Experience with an enterprise HCM such as ADP, Workday, or UKG, and an applicant tracking system. High attention to detail and discretion handling confidential employee and compensation data. Preferred: Exposure to multi-entity or multi-country workforce data (e.g., US, UK, India, Australia). Familiarity with API, SFTP, or flat-file integrations, access reviews, and SOX-style control evidence. Experience using or testing generative AI or natural-language analytics tools. PHR, SHRM-CP, or a data analytics certification. About Ziff Davis Ziff Davis (NASDAQ: ZD) is a vertically focused digital media and internet company whose portfolio includes leading brands in technology, shopping, gaming and entertainment, health, cybersecurity, and martech. Today, Ziff Davis is focused on six key verticals – Technology, Shopping, Entertainment, Health & Wellness, Cybersecurity and Marketing Technology. Its brands include IGN, Mashable, RetailMeNot, PCMag, Humble Bundle, Spiceworks, Everyday Health, BabyCenter, Moz, iContact and Vipre Security. Title: Human Data Quality Engineer (Founding Team)
Industries: Construction, Software Development, and IT Services and IT Consulting
Description: Human Data Quality Engineer (Founding Team) Prolific Prolific isn’t just enabling AI innovation – we’re redefining it. While foundational AI technologies are becoming commoditized, Prolific’s human data infrastructure provides the high-quality, diverse data required to train the next generation of AI models. Through our platform, we empower researchers and companies to access a global, ethically curated participant base, ensuring cutting-edge AI research and training grounded in inclusivity and precision. The Role As one of the founding members of Prolific's newly formed AI Data Services team, you'll help build the quality systems behind some of the world's most advanced AI models. Data quality is a strategic priority for Prolific, so this is a high-visibility role with direct exposure to senior stakeholders. This isn't a traditional QA role. We are not looking for someone to review data against a predefined checklist. We are looking for an innovative thinker that can leverage their expertise to define what good means where no definition exists yet. Acting as a strategic thought partner, you’ll work at the intersection of human data, machine learning, evaluation across frontier use-cases that define what high-quality human data looks like for the next generation of advanced AI. This means that much of the work involves novel problems with no established answer, so you’ll be comfortable working through ambiguity.. . Your primary focus is working directly with clients and alongside frontier AI labs, translating what their models need into robust human data and evaluation strategies. Rather than checking quality at the end of a project, you'll engineer quality into every stage of the lifecycle, from study design and participant strategy through to evaluation, launch readiness and client delivery.You will also work alongside our product engineering, and supply teams to define and build the quality infrastructure that will enable us to deliver high quality human data at scale. Much of the work you'll tackle won't have an existing playbook. You'll help create it. What You’ll Be Doing Design the quality frameworks that underpin complex human data programmes, from evaluation rubrics through to launch readiness. Work with clients as a strategic thought partner, challenging annotation schemas and data requirements when they won't produce the signal the model needs. Advise on project design and how the choice of schema can impact data quality. Build quality upstream across the operational workflow, from recruitment, screening, and training through to writing guidelines and running calibration sessions. Build scalable quality systems, measurement frameworks and automated checks using Python and SQL. Partner with product and engineering to build the quality infrastructure that delivers high-quality human data at scale. Investigate data quality and integrity issues, identifying root causes and turning insights into scalable improvements. Architect and build dashboards, monitoring and reporting that provide clear visibility into quality and operational performance. Raise the quality capability across the company, upskilling operations and acting as a thought mentor to junior analysts. Help define how Prolific approaches quality across new AI domains, shaping best practice as the team grows. What You’ll Bring to the Role 5+ years of experience in building quality, evaluation or annotation systems within AI, machine learning, LLMs or human data environments. Strong Python and SQL skills, with a passion for using data to solve complex quality problems. A solid understanding of machine learning pipelines and how human data impacts model performance. Strong analytical and statistical thinking, with experience designing scalable quality frameworks. The confidence and credibility to interact with stakeholders at frontier labs and act as a partner. The ability to leverage your experience and expertise to influence and guide stakeholders at every level, both client side and internally. in The ability to turn your own data analysis and quality methodology into requirements that product and engineering can build into systems. The ability to explain yout data analysis and findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders, so they can act on them. A proactive, builder's mindset -you enjoy creating new systems, navigating ambiguity and improving how things work. Even Better if you have: Experience with LLM evaluation, RLHF, AI safety or red teaming. Experience translating vague model or evaluation goals into clear annotation specifications. Experience working with human annotation programmes or human data operations. Familiarity with calibration, inter-rater agreement, drift detection or other evaluation methodologies. Why Prolific is a great place to work We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems. We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity. Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture. Es importante contar con experiencia en réplicas de valuación, VaR, curvas de descuento, payoffs de derivados, escenarios de estrés, P&L, conciliación y calidad de datos. Ejecutar pruebas a nivel instrumento, portafolio y mesa, contrastando valuaciones y métricas contra Murex. Registrar diferencias y evidencias, analizar causas raíz y apoyar en el cierre de discrepancias identificadas durante las validaciones. Asegurar la conciliación, calidad y trazabilidad de datos utilizados en los procesos de valuación y medición de riesgo. ¿Qué te ofrecemos? Title: Analista de riesgos de crédito
Description: SOMOS LIDERAZGO CON CONCIENCIA En Natura, tenemos el potencial de impulsar transformaciones significativas. Ocupación Permanente Propósito del Puesto El objetivo principal de esta posición es actuar como un facilitador seguro para las ventas de la compañía, garantizando un equilibrio entre el crecimiento comercial y la mitigación del riesgo financiero. El/la titular del puesto es responsable de analizar, asignar y controlar las líneas de crédito (Score/Comportamiento), asegurar el cumplimiento normativo (Controles SOX), gestionar el presupuesto de proveedores de crédito y liderar las iniciativas de prevención de fraude y ética empresarial. Responsabilidades Principales y Funciones Detalladas Asignación de Límites de Crédito y Análisis de Riesgo (DataLab & Sistemas) Colaborar con el equipo de Data para evaluar la política de crédito, analizar scores de riesgo y determinar las asignaciones adecuadas. Ejecutar la carga masiva y correcta de la información Realizar revisiones y validación de información crítica como facturación, morosidad y uso máximo de líneas de crédito. Generar resúmenes de crédito promedio por variables (Riesgo, Score,) y cruzar esta información con bases de disminución de crédito para asegurar reinicios seguros de cartera. Aplicar modelos de Behavior Score y gestionar créditos personalizados por región. Control de Liberación de Pedidos y Habilitación de Ventas Gestión de Herramientas: Dar seguimiento al sistema automatizado encargado de autorizar los pedidos de forma rápida. Evaluación Diaria de Crédito (Credit Check): Revisar y aprobar o rechazar las entregas de pedidos que superan el límite de crédito permitido, coordinando con el equipo de Cuentas. Solución de Casos y Ajuste de Reglas: Dar seguimiento a pedidos detenidos y ajustar las reglas operativas en el sistema. Prevención de Fraudes y Comité de Ética Liderar la investigación y seguimiento de reportes de "mala práctica" Analizar el impacto del fraude cruzando variables clave Gestionar y concluir proyectos antifraude tecnológicos. Alinear estrategias y presentar las bajas definitivas por ética en conjunto con las áreas Comercial y Legal, buscando siempre la mejora de los procesos preventivos. Cumplimiento, Auditoría y Controles SOX Actuar como punto de contacto principal para la extracción, revisión y entrega de evidencias mensuales requeridas por las auditorías internas y externas (Controles SOX). Administración Financiera, SAP y Pago a Proveedores Llevar el control total del presupuesto y pago a los proveedores de servicios del área de Crédito. Comunicación Estratégica Interdepartamental Generar briefs y alinear la comunicación oficial del área de Crédito hacia el equipo de campo y Comercial. Participar activamente en consultorías, foros (FOCE) y reuniones comerciales para dar visibilidad de las estrategias de crédito, garantizando que los mensajes sean claros y cuenten con el respaldo de las áreas involucradas. Title: Manager, Data Engineering
Description: Somos una empresa omnicanal impulsada por las personas y habilitada por la tecnología, dedicada a ayudar a las personas a ahorrar dinero y vivir mejor. En 2009, Walmart de México y Walmart Centroamérica iniciaron una nueva etapa de crecimiento al convertirse en un solo equipo. Desde 2010, operamos como Walmart de México y Centroamérica, una de las organizaciones de retail más importantes de la región. Nuestra estrategia omnicanal está centrada en nuestros clientes y enfocada en mejorar continuamente su experiencia de compra. Tenemos presencia en seis países: México, Guatemala, El Salvador, Honduras, Nicaragua y Costa Rica. Operamos 4,079 tiendas en toda la región, de las cuales 3,154 se encuentran en México y 925 en Centroamérica. Actualmente, más de 6 millones de clientes visitan diariamente nuestras tiendas y clubes en México y Centroamérica. Continuamos ofreciendo a nuestros clientes los productos que necesitan a precios bajos todos los días mediante un portafolio diverso de formatos de negocio, cada uno con una propuesta de valor única. Al mismo tiempo, seguimos acelerando nuestra estrategia de transformación digital para brindar una mejor experiencia a nuestros clientes y socios en todos los canales y en cada etapa de su recorrido de compra. Descripción del empleo Resumen En Walmart de México y Centroamérica , impulsamos el retail del futuro a través de datos y tecnología de vanguardia. Buscamos un(a) Data Engineering Manager con una sólida base técnica en sistemas distribuidos de gran escala, arquitectura de datos y desarrollo de software para unirse a nuestro equipo de Global Tech / Data & AI . Liderarás y mentorizarás a un equipo de ingeniería de datos de alto rendimiento, pero también mantendrás un rol activo en el diseño técnico, la revisión de arquitectura y la escritura de código de calidad de producción para nuestras plataformas a escala petabyte. Tu misión será habilitar capacidades analíticas avanzadas, integraciones de Inteligencia Artificial (GenAI/ML) y soluciones de negocio en tiempo real que impactan directamente a millones de clientes en nuestro ecosistema omnicanal. ¿Qué harás? Liderar y mentorizar: Dirigir, inspirar y guiar a ingenieros de datos ( Data, Analytics y Software Engineers ) a través de un liderazgo técnico proactivo, promoviendo planes de carrera y la excelencia en ingeniería. Desarrollo Hands-On: Diseñar, desarrollar y optimizar pipelines de datos distribuidos complejos de extremo a extremo (E2E), manteniendo un rol activo en el diseño y la escritura de código robusto. Diseñar arquitecturas modernas: Definir la hoja de ruta técnica de la plataforma de datos corporativa y estructurar arquitecturas modernas ( Lakehouse, Data Mesh, Lambda/Kappa ) para soportar procesamiento masivo en batch y streaming . Gobernar y monitorear: Implementar marcos automatizados de calidad, observabilidad ( data observability ), linaje y catalogación, garantizando alta disponibilidad y el cumplimiento de normativas de seguridad y privacidad. Optimizar recursos (FinOps): Monitorear y optimizar la infraestructura de almacenamiento y procesamiento en la nube, garantizando el costo-eficiencia de las operaciones. Colaborar estratégicamente: Actuar como puente técnico con equipos de Product Management, Ciencia de Datos y líderes globales para traducir desafíos comerciales en productos de datos escalables. Requisitos ¿Qué buscamos? Trayectoria profesional: Mínimo 8 años de experiencia en ingeniería de software o datos, incluyendo al menos 3 años liderando de forma directa y técnica a equipos de ingeniería. Ingeniería de datos de alta especialidad: Sólida base en computación distribuida y experiencia comprobada desarrollando sistemas distribuidos con Apache Spark, Hadoop, Hive y SQL complejo. Sólido dominio de programación: Experiencia impecable escribiendo código de producción en Python, Java o Scala . Arquitectura de datos y mensajería: Diseño de pipelines de datos y arquitecturas orientadas a eventos en tiempo real con Kafka o plataformas similares. Ecosistema Cloud y DevOps: Experiencia en el diseño de plataformas de datos cloud-native utilizando GCP, Azure o AWS , así como en la implementación rigurosa de CI/CD para datos. Idioma: Nivel de inglés profesional avanzado (C1/C2) para interactuar, presentar y colaborar diariamente de manera fluida con equipos de Walmart Inc. en EE. UU. y regiones globales. Valoramos adicionalmente Experiencia previa implementando observabilidad de datos (p. ej., Monte Carlo, Great Expectations) y optimización bajo principios de FinOps. Experiencia de diseño y modelado de almacenamiento moderno con dbt, Databricks o Snowflake. Certificaciones vigentes como Cloud Data Architect o Data Engineer (GCP, Azure o Databricks). Experiencia en industrias de Retail, E-commerce, Logística global o Big Tech a gran escala. Información adicional En Walmart de México y Centroamérica estamos comprometidos con una cultura de pertenencia, por lo que buscamos incorporar el mejor talento basándonos en competencias, habilidades y potencial; no discriminamos por ningún motivo, incluyendo género, edad, origen étnico, apariencia física, estado civil, condiciones de salud por VIH o cualquier enfermedad, situación socioeconómica, discapacidad, orientación sexual, identidad o expresión de género por ello durante el proceso de atracción y selección no solicitaremos información personal, fotografías o análisis clínicos de ningún tipo. Los datos personales del candidato o candidata no son relevantes durante el proceso de entrevista ni para la selección final. Description: Ford Champs looks forward to providing you with key knowledge and significant experiences for your professional career. This is a great platform to connect with leadership, collaborate with professionals in many areas of the business and learn more about our Ford full time opportunities. Throughout this program, there are many opportunities to gain insight and exposure to our business that will last a lifetime. As a Powertrain Calibration & Automation Engineering Ford Champ, you will bridge vehicle engineering and software automation within our Powertrain Calibration and Validation team. You will drive engineering efficiency by building automated tools, managing centralized connector databases, and digitizing technical schematics for vehicle diagnostics and emissions calibration. This opportunity offers real-world automotive exposure, hands-on mentorship from senior calibration engineers, and direct experience solving complex data challenges. What You’ll Do Automate sensor diagrams and schematic generation in Microsoft Visio using custom VBA scripts, macros, and API integrations to accelerate vehicle design verification. Develop and maintain Python and MATLAB scripts to automate vehicle test data parsing, sensor wiring checks, and analytical summary reporting. Build, maintain, and populate a centralized relational database defining sensor connector pinouts, electrical specifications, and Electronic Control Unit (ECU) interface assignments. Collaborate with Powertrain Calibration and Diagnostics Engineers to structure, review, and track vehicle test plans and diagnostic monitoring workflows across active programs. Analyze exhaust and On-Board Diagnostic (OBD) sensor functionality to ensure automated system schematics reflect precise electrical and functional operating requirements. Apply continuous improvement principles to optimize data handoffs and resolve workflow bottlenecks across validation, calibration, and systems engineering teams. Microsoft Visio skills or Visio API: Experience with VBA macros, stencil automation, or automated diagram drawing. Python programming: Proficiency in scripting, data manipulation (e.g., pandas), and automation scripts.
